title: ADF Master Roadmap
description: Target: Product Owner / Program-Delivery Manager / Cloud-Engineering Manager. Focus: architecture, orchestration, data movement, networking, security, operations, cost, Databricks integration and interview readiness.

topics.title: What Azure Data Factory Is
topics.learning_objective: Understand ADF as a managed cloud data-integration and orchestration service; distinguish orchestration, movement and transformation.
topics.success_criteria: Explain what ADF does, where it fits in an Azure data platform, and why it is not the primary compute engine for heavy transformation.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain what ADF does, where it fits in an Azure data platform, and why it is not the primary compute engine for heavy transformation.
topics.evidence_notes: Write a one-minute ADF explanation for a Product/Program interview.

topics.title: ADF vs Databricks vs Synapse vs Fabric Data Factory
topics.learning_objective: Understand where ADF, Databricks, Synapse and Fabric Data Factory overlap and where they serve different architectural roles.
topics.success_criteria: Choose the right service for orchestration, transformation, lakehouse processing and integrated analytics, with explicit trade-offs.
topics.evidence_criterion: Choose the right service for orchestration, transformation, lakehouse processing and integrated analytics, with explicit trade-offs.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a service-selection matrix for 4 common enterprise scenarios.

topics.title: ADF Resource Model
topics.learning_objective: Learn factory, pipeline, activity, dataset, linked service, trigger and pipeline run relationships.
topics.success_criteria: Draw the object model without mixing connection metadata, data metadata and execution state.
topics.evidence_criterion: Draw the object model without mixing connection metadata, data metadata and execution state.
topics.evidence_notes: Produce an ADF object relationship diagram.

topics.title: ADF Mental Model for Managers
topics.learning_objective: Translate ADF concepts into ownership, risk, SLA, dependency, cost and operational language.
topics.success_criteria: Explain an ADF design to PO/PM/EM stakeholders without pretending to be an ADF developer.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain an ADF design to PO/PM/EM stakeholders without pretending to be an ADF developer.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a one-page manager mental model.

topics.title: Linked Services
topics.learning_objective: Understand connection information, authentication, connectVia and target-system permissions.
topics.success_criteria: Explain how credentials and connectivity are separated from pipeline logic.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain how credentials and connectivity are separated from pipeline logic.
topics.evidence_notes: Build a linked-service decision checklist.

topics.title: Datasets and Parameterisation
topics.learning_objective: Understand datasets as reusable views of data and parameterise paths, tables and filenames.
topics.success_criteria: Explain pipeline → dataset parameter flow and avoid hard-coded source/sink definitions.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain pipeline → dataset parameter flow and avoid hard-coded source/sink definitions.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a parameterised dataset pattern for table/date.

topics.title: Pipeline Parameters, Variables and Expressions
topics.learning_objective: Understand read-only parameters, mutable variables, expression evaluation and dynamic content.
topics.success_criteria: Correctly choose between parameter, variable and expression and explain parallel-loop variable risk.
topics.evidence_criterion: Correctly choose between parameter, variable and expression and explain parallel-loop variable risk.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a reusable pipeline parameter model.

topics.title: Global Parameters and Reusable Configuration
topics.learning_objective: Understand factory-wide configuration and environment-specific values.
topics.success_criteria: Explain when a value belongs at pipeline, dataset, linked-service or factory scope.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain when a value belongs at pipeline, dataset, linked-service or factory scope.
topics.evidence_notes: Design Dev/Test/Prod configuration boundaries.

topics.title: Activity Types and Execution Semantics
topics.learning_objective: Understand data movement, transformation and control-flow activities and their execution model.
topics.success_criteria: Classify an activity correctly and explain what executes in ADF versus a downstream compute service.
topics.evidence_criterion: Classify an activity correctly and explain what executes in ADF versus a downstream compute service.
topics.evidence_notes: Map 15 common activities to their category and execution location.

topics.title: Dependencies: Success, Failure, Completion and Skip
topics.learning_objective: Understand dependency conditions and how activity graphs determine pipeline outcomes.
topics.success_criteria: Design a failure notification and cleanup flow without accidentally masking failures.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design a failure notification and cleanup flow without accidentally masking failures.
topics.evidence_notes: Build a Try/Catch-style control-flow design on paper.

topics.title: Lookup and Get Metadata
topics.learning_objective: Understand metadata discovery, output limits and common control-table patterns.
topics.success_criteria: Know when Lookup is appropriate and when its output constraints require a different pattern.
topics.evidence_criterion: Know when Lookup is appropriate and when its output constraints require a different pattern.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a control-table discovery flow.

topics.title: ForEach, Batch Count and Parallelism
topics.learning_objective: Understand iteration, parallel execution, batchCount and nesting restrictions.
topics.success_criteria: Explain why parallel loops can create race conditions and source/sink pressure.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain why parallel loops can create race conditions and source/sink pressure.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a 1,000-table metadata-driven loop safely.

topics.title: If Condition, Switch, Until and Wait
topics.learning_objective: Understand branching, polling and controlled repetition.
topics.success_criteria: Choose the correct control construct instead of overusing nested pipelines.
topics.evidence_criterion: Choose the correct control construct instead of overusing nested pipelines.
topics.evidence_notes: Map 5 workflow requirements to the correct activity.

topics.title: Execute Pipeline and Reusable Child Pipelines
topics.learning_objective: Understand parent/child composition and reusable orchestration units.
topics.success_criteria: Explain how child pipelines reduce duplication while keeping ownership and observability clear.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain how child pipelines reduce duplication while keeping ownership and observability clear.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a parent pipeline + reusable child pipeline architecture.

topics.title: Web, Function, Script and Stored Procedure Integration
topics.learning_objective: Understand when ADF calls external services versus executes database-side logic.
topics.success_criteria: Choose the right integration mechanism and identify security, timeout and retry implications.
topics.evidence_criterion: Choose the right integration mechanism and identify security, timeout and retry implications.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a decision table for Web/Function/Script/Stored Procedure.

topics.title: Schedule Triggers
topics.learning_objective: Understand wall-clock execution, trigger-run relationships and operational implications.
topics.success_criteria: Explain why a schedule trigger does not inherently model data completeness for a time window.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain why a schedule trigger does not inherently model data completeness for a time window.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a daily 05:15 ingestion schedule.

topics.title: Tumbling Window Triggers
topics.learning_objective: Understand stateful windows, backfill, retry, delay, concurrency and dependencies.
topics.success_criteria: Choose tumbling windows when the processing unit is a time window and missed windows matter.
topics.evidence_criterion: Choose tumbling windows when the processing unit is a time window and missed windows matter.
topics.evidence_notes: Design an hourly load with backfill and late-data delay.

topics.title: Event and Custom Event Triggers
topics.learning_objective: Understand storage events and custom Event Grid events.
topics.success_criteria: Select event triggering when data arrival, not wall-clock time, is the true trigger condition.
topics.evidence_criterion: Select event triggering when data arrival, not wall-clock time, is the true trigger condition.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a file-arrival ingestion trigger with safe filtering.

topics.title: Time Zones and Window Semantics
topics.learning_objective: Understand UTC, daylight-saving behavior and window boundaries.
topics.success_criteria: Explain how time-zone choices affect schedules, partitions and reconciliation.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain how time-zone choices affect schedules, partitions and reconciliation.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a UTC-based scheduling standard.

topics.title: Integration Runtime Fundamentals
topics.learning_objective: Understand Azure IR, Self-hosted IR and Azure-SSIS IR as the three main IR families.
topics.success_criteria: Select the appropriate runtime based on connectivity, execution type and operational ownership.
topics.evidence_criterion: Select the appropriate runtime based on connectivity, execution type and operational ownership.
topics.evidence_notes: Create an IR decision tree.

topics.title: Self-hosted IR Architecture and Operations
topics.learning_objective: Understand SHIR installation, network reachability, scale-out/HA, patching, proxies and ownership.
topics.success_criteria: Explain why SHIR is production infrastructure and what the support model must contain.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain why SHIR is production infrastructure and what the support model must contain.
topics.evidence_notes: Write a SHIR production handover checklist.

topics.title: Managed VNet and Managed Private Endpoints
topics.learning_objective: Understand Managed VNet as an Azure IR configuration and how managed private endpoints provide private connectivity.
topics.success_criteria: Distinguish Managed VNet, managed private endpoint and a private endpoint for the Data Factory service.
topics.evidence_criterion: Distinguish Managed VNet, managed private endpoint and a private endpoint for the Data Factory service.
topics.evidence_notes: Draw a private ADF network topology.

topics.title: On-premises Connectivity and Network Paths
topics.learning_objective: Understand SHIR, ExpressRoute, VPN, Private Link and firewall constraints.
topics.success_criteria: Explain the network path instead of saying 'SHIR removes networking'.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain the network path instead of saying 'SHIR removes networking'.
topics.evidence_notes: Compare three on-premises connectivity topologies.

topics.title: Private Endpoint vs Managed Private Endpoint
topics.learning_objective: Understand the separate purposes of private access to the factory service versus target data stores.
topics.success_criteria: Avoid conflating authoring/control traffic with data-plane connectivity.
topics.evidence_criterion: Avoid conflating authoring/control traffic with data-plane connectivity.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a four-term networking glossary.

topics.title: Copy Activity Fundamentals
topics.learning_objective: Understand source → read/serialize → map/convert → write/sink flow.
topics.success_criteria: Explain where Copy runs and what it does itself versus what downstream engines do.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain where Copy runs and what it does itself versus what downstream engines do.
topics.evidence_notes: Design one cloud-to-cloud and one hybrid copy pipeline.

topics.title: Connectors, Formats and Capability Matrix
topics.learning_objective: Understand that connector capability is connector/version-specific and should be verified against current Microsoft documentation.
topics.success_criteria: Avoid memorising stale source-only/sink-only lists; verify capability when designing.
topics.evidence_criterion: Avoid memorising stale source-only/sink-only lists; verify capability when designing.
topics.evidence_notes: Build a connector capability checklist for SQL, Oracle, S3, ADLS and REST.

topics.title: Schema Mapping and Type Conversion
topics.learning_objective: Understand column mapping, type conversion, truncation and explicit mapping.
topics.success_criteria: Identify precision-loss and schema-mismatch risks before production.
topics.evidence_criterion: Identify precision-loss and schema-mismatch risks before production.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a type-conversion risk checklist.

topics.title: Fault Tolerance and Skipped Rows
topics.learning_objective: Understand incompatible-row behavior, skipped rows and session logs.
topics.success_criteria: Decide when to fail a load versus quarantine bad records and who owns the resulting data-quality workflow.
topics.evidence_criterion: Decide when to fail a load versus quarantine bad records and who owns the resulting data-quality workflow.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a bad-row quarantine operating model.

topics.title: Data Consistency Verification
topics.learning_objective: Understand what ADF can verify automatically and what it cannot prove.
topics.success_criteria: Explain why 'verified' does not equal business-level correctness.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain why 'verified' does not equal business-level correctness.
topics.evidence_notes: Define a migration acceptance criterion beyond Copy success.

topics.title: Staged Copy, Resume and Large File Handling
topics.learning_objective: Understand staged copy, file hierarchy requirements and supported resume scenarios.
topics.success_criteria: Design recovery around what ADF actually resumes instead of assuming all copies checkpoint.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design recovery around what ADF actually resumes instead of assuming all copies checkpoint.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a copy-recovery decision tree.

topics.title: Full Load vs Incremental Load
topics.learning_objective: Understand initial snapshot, delta loads and when full reload remains appropriate.
topics.success_criteria: Choose a loading strategy based on source capabilities, volume and recovery needs.
topics.evidence_criterion: Choose a loading strategy based on source capabilities, volume and recovery needs.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a load-strategy decision table.

topics.title: Watermark Patterns
topics.learning_objective: Understand monotonic IDs, last-modified timestamps, high-water marks and delete limitations.
topics.success_criteria: Design a watermark safely and explain failure cases such as late updates and clock problems.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design a watermark safely and explain failure cases such as late updates and clock problems.
topics.evidence_notes: Build a watermark control-table design.

topics.title: Change Tracking and CDC
topics.learning_objective: Understand Change Tracking vs CDC and their source-system prerequisites.
topics.success_criteria: Explain when a watermark is insufficient because updates/deletes must be observed.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain when a watermark is insufficient because updates/deletes must be observed.
topics.evidence_notes: Compare watermark, Change Tracking and CDC for three databases.

topics.title: CDC Checkpoints and Rename Risk
topics.learning_objective: Understand checkpoint identity, current Microsoft documentation differences and explicit-key practices.
topics.success_criteria: Explain the current uncertainty accurately instead of giving a universal rename rule.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain the current uncertainty accurately instead of giving a universal rename rule.
topics.evidence_notes: Write a CDC rename/change-management runbook.

topics.title: Metadata-Driven Pipelines
topics.learning_objective: Understand control tables, reusable pipelines, parameterised datasets and dynamic execution.
topics.success_criteria: Design one pipeline serving many tables without turning the metadata layer into an ungoverned framework.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design one pipeline serving many tables without turning the metadata layer into an ungoverned framework.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a metadata-driven ingestion framework.

topics.title: Mapping Data Flows
topics.learning_objective: Understand visual transformations running on ADF-managed Spark.
topics.success_criteria: Know when Mapping Data Flow is appropriate versus Databricks or SQL.
topics.evidence_criterion: Know when Mapping Data Flow is appropriate versus Databricks or SQL.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a transformation-selection matrix.

topics.title: Schema Drift and Data Flow Design
topics.learning_objective: Understand schema drift and how it affects resilient ingestion.
topics.success_criteria: Make schema evolution a deliberate design decision rather than an accidental behavior.
topics.evidence_criterion: Make schema evolution a deliberate design decision rather than an accidental behavior.
topics.evidence_notes: Define schema-evolution rules for a lake ingestion domain.

topics.title: Reconciliation: Counts, Profiles and Row Fingerprints
topics.learning_objective: Understand multi-level validation: counts, aggregates, distributions, row hashes and business rules.
topics.success_criteria: Design reconciliation that can detect offsetting errors, not just matched totals.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design reconciliation that can detect offsetting errors, not just matched totals.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a five-level migration reconciliation plan.

topics.title: Assert, Error Rows and Business Rules
topics.learning_objective: Understand data-quality assertions and error handling in Data Flows.
topics.success_criteria: Turn business rules into explicit acceptance criteria and failure paths.
topics.evidence_criterion: Turn business rules into explicit acceptance criteria and failure paths.
topics.evidence_notes: Implement a logical data-quality gate design.

topics.title: Data Flow Performance Fundamentals
topics.learning_objective: Understand cluster startup, TTL, partitioning, skew and shuffle-related tuning.
topics.success_criteria: Diagnose the actual bottleneck before changing cluster size or partition settings.
topics.evidence_criterion: Diagnose the actual bottleneck before changing cluster size or partition settings.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a Data Flow performance troubleshooting checklist.

topics.title: Managed Identity, Key Vault and Authentication
topics.learning_objective: Understand identity choices, secrets management and connector-specific authentication.
topics.success_criteria: Design credential handling without hard-coding secrets and explain authentication trade-offs.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design credential handling without hard-coding secrets and explain authentication trade-offs.
topics.evidence_notes: Create an enterprise credential-management pattern.

topics.title: CMK and Factory Encryption
topics.learning_objective: Understand CMK setup paths, prerequisites, immutability and key-management consequences.
topics.success_criteria: Explain when encryption choices must be made early in the factory lifecycle.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain when encryption choices must be made early in the factory lifecycle.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a CMK decision checklist.

topics.title: Trusted Service: Legacy vs Modern
topics.learning_objective: Understand Legacy/Modern trusted-service modes and the enterprise migration implication.
topics.success_criteria: Explain the current recommended direction and avoid assuming firewall bypass is timeless.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain the current recommended direction and avoid assuming firewall bypass is timeless.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a legacy-to-modern migration watch item.

topics.title: Monitoring, Alerts and Run History
topics.learning_objective: Understand pipeline runs, activity runs, diagnostics, alerts and retention.
topics.success_criteria: Define what operations should monitor beyond a green pipeline status.
topics.evidence_criterion: Define what operations should monitor beyond a green pipeline status.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a production monitoring checklist and alert matrix.

topics.title: Operational Logging and Sensitive Data
topics.learning_objective: Understand secureInput/secureOutput, monitoring exposure and the risks of session logs/data preview.
topics.success_criteria: Design logging that supports operations without unnecessarily exposing sensitive data.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design logging that supports operations without unnecessarily exposing sensitive data.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a regulated-data monitoring policy.

topics.title: Git Integration and Collaboration
topics.learning_objective: Understand source control, collaboration, pull requests and environment separation.
topics.success_criteria: Explain why Git is the source of truth without claiming it is a universal ADF product requirement.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain why Git is the source of truth without claiming it is a universal ADF product requirement.
topics.evidence_notes: Create an ADF branch/PR strategy.

topics.title: ARM Templates and Automated Publishing
topics.learning_objective: Understand `adf_publish`, automated validation/export and deployment artifacts.
topics.success_criteria: Explain both supported template-generation approaches and their operational trade-offs.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain both supported template-generation approaches and their operational trade-offs.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a Dev→Test→Prod deployment flow.

topics.title: Bicep and Infrastructure as Code
topics.learning_objective: Understand where Bicep complements ADF resource deployment and environment provisioning.
topics.success_criteria: Explain what belongs in infrastructure-as-code versus factory content deployment.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain what belongs in infrastructure-as-code versus factory content deployment.
topics.evidence_notes: Draft an ADF environment provisioning outline in Bicep.

topics.title: Deployment Parameters, Global Parameters and Trigger Handling
topics.learning_objective: Understand parameterisation across environments and the operational implications of active triggers.
topics.success_criteria: Build a release checklist that separates product changes from environment configuration.
topics.evidence_criterion: Build a release checklist that separates product changes from environment configuration.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a deployment readiness checklist.

topics.title: Reliability, Idempotency and Recovery
topics.learning_objective: Understand transient failures, retries, duplicate risk, reruns and regional/zone recovery concepts.
topics.success_criteria: Design reruns that are safe and explain reliability as a shared responsibility.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design reruns that are safe and explain reliability as a shared responsibility.
topics.evidence_notes: Write an incident-recovery runbook for a failed nightly load.

topics.title: Copy Performance: DIUs, Parallel Copies and Bottlenecks
topics.learning_objective: Understand DIUs, parallel copies, queueing, source latency and sink throttling.
topics.success_criteria: Diagnose the slowest stage before scaling compute and articulate the cost/speed trade-off.
topics.evidence_criterion: Diagnose the slowest stage before scaling compute and articulate the cost/speed trade-off.
topics.evidence_notes: Create a Copy performance diagnosis decision tree.

topics.title: ADF Cost Model and FinOps
topics.learning_objective: Understand orchestration runs, DIU-hours, vCore-hours, SSIS and other operation costs.
topics.success_criteria: Estimate cost from workload behavior and identify levers that reduce spend without breaking SLA.
topics.evidence_criterion: Estimate cost from workload behavior and identify levers that reduce spend without breaking SLA.
topics.evidence_notes: Build a simple ADF cost-driver model.

topics.title: Scale and Concurrency Trade-offs
topics.learning_objective: Understand pipeline concurrency, ForEach concurrency, source pressure and destination limits.
topics.success_criteria: Balance throughput, recovery, fairness and source-system safety.
topics.evidence_criterion: Balance throughput, recovery, fairness and source-system safety.
topics.evidence_notes: Design a concurrency budget for a multi-source platform.

topics.title: Architecture Trade-offs: ADF vs Databricks vs Synapse
topics.learning_objective: Reason about orchestration vs transformation vs SQL analytics and platform ownership.
topics.success_criteria: Defend architecture choices with performance, cost, operational and team-skill trade-offs.
topics.evidence_criterion: Defend architecture choices with performance, cost, operational and team-skill trade-offs.
topics.evidence_notes: Present an architecture choice for a lakehouse ingestion platform.

topics.title: ADF + Azure Databricks
topics.learning_objective: Understand notebook activity, parameter passing, outputs, orchestration boundaries and failure handling.
topics.success_criteria: Explain where ADF stops and Databricks starts in a production data platform.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain where ADF stops and Databricks starts in a production data platform.
topics.evidence_notes: Design an ADF→Databricks→validation workflow.

topics.title: ADF + Azure Synapse
topics.learning_objective: Understand common orchestration patterns, notebook/SQL integration and sink choices.
topics.success_criteria: Explain when Synapse-native capabilities change the ADF architecture.
topics.evidence_criterion: Explain when Synapse-native capabilities change the ADF architecture.
topics.evidence_notes: Design an ADF + Synapse batch architecture.

topics.title: ADF vs Fabric Data Factory in 2026
topics.learning_objective: Understand Microsoft's current Fabric positioning, migration considerations and capability differences.
topics.success_criteria: Answer 'Would you build new pipelines in ADF or Fabric?' with current, nuanced reasoning.
topics.evidence_criterion: Answer 'Would you build new pipelines in ADF or Fabric?' with current, nuanced reasoning.
topics.evidence_notes: Prepare a 3-minute ADF vs Fabric executive answer.

topics.title: Enterprise Migration Architecture
topics.learning_objective: Combine connectivity, control tables, incremental loads, reconciliation, security, CI/CD, monitoring and cutover.
topics.success_criteria: Design a migration plan that an EM/Program Manager can challenge on risk, ownership, throughput and recovery.
topics.evidence_criterion: Design a migration plan that an EM/Program Manager can challenge on risk, ownership, throughput and recovery.
topics.evidence_notes: Complete an end-to-end 100–500 table Azure migration architecture case.

topics.title: ADF Interview Scenario Drills
topics.learning_objective: Practice failure, cost, security, migration, reliability and architecture scenarios using the course's scenarios.
topics.success_criteria: Answer with facts, trade-offs, assumptions, operational consequences and measurable acceptance criteria.
topics.evidence_criterion: Answer with facts, trade-offs, assumptions, operational consequences and measurable acceptance criteria.
topics.evidence_notes: Record or write answers to 10 ADF interview scenarios.

topics.title: ADF Architecture Review Capstone
topics.learning_objective: Conduct a structured review of an ADF design from user requirement through production operations.
topics.success_criteria: Defend architecture, security, networking, recovery, cost and delivery decisions under interview pressure.
topics.evidence_criterion: Defend architecture, security, networking, recovery, cost and delivery decisions under interview pressure.
topics.evidence_notes: Produce an architecture-review document plus 2-minute executive summary.

resources.title: Mental Model
rows: Conductor + data movement service; transformation often happens elsewhere.
What is ADF orchestrating, and what service is doing the heavy work?
What is the business job this pipeline owns?
What exactly executes here and where?
Who owns the credential and network path?
What data shape/location the activity works with.
Can this be parameterised or should it be dynamic?
Where the movement/data-flow execution happens and what network it can reach.
Why this IR, and who operates it?
The condition that starts the pipeline.
Is time, data arrival, or another event the real trigger?
Clock-based schedule vs stateful time-window processing.
Do I need backfill and window state?
Mutable scratch state within pipeline execution.
Can the source expose all changes I need, including deletes?
One reusable pipeline driven by control metadata.
Am I standardising a pattern or creating a framework nobody owns?
Repeat execution has the same business effect as one execution.
Can I safely rerun this after failure?
